box-header.title: The domains could not be read

default-field.title: Host name
default-field.tooltip: A public name whose DNS points at this node, such as erp.example.com. A name goes to one local node: one another node has is refused

default-field.title: Mode
default-field.tooltip: Passthrough: the local node ends TLS with its own certificate, and this node sees no content; while its link is down the connection is refused. Terminate: this node ends TLS with its own certificate and forwards each request; while the link is down it shows an offline page

default-field.title: Sticky cookie
default-field.tooltip: For a terminate name whose local node is a cluster: the cookie its requests are sticky by, so a browser session stays on one member. Empty for this node's default, the session cookie

label.text: The public names this node answers for its local nodes, each for one. A passthrough name's TLS goes to the local node unopened; a terminate name's requests are forwarded. A local node's own setup adds and removes its names too.

default-field.title: Sticky by
default-field.tooltip: A terminate name's requests go to its local node's members sticky by this cookie; a passthrough name's connections by the client's address

default-field.title: Cookie
default-field.tooltip: The cookie whose value picks the member for each request; empty for this node's default

link.confirmation: Remove ${hostName}? This node stops answering for it.

label.text: No host names yet. Add one for a paired local node, and point its DNS at this node.

What each local node's own setup, from its Edge Node wizard, sent besides its host names, and the numbers its copies have. Each name, domain, number and site belongs to one local node: the first to claim it.

default-field.title: Mail domains
default-field.tooltip: Mail to these domains goes to this node, by its replicated recipients; another node may have other addresses in the same domain

default-field.title: Chat bridges
default-field.tooltip: Bridge ids may be the same on two nodes: a webhook goes by the request's host name first

default-field.title: PASS sites
default-field.tooltip: The mr-pass sites whose authority this node is

label.text: No conflicts: every local node's records are applied.
